definitions.gloss: bribe; illicit payment to gain favor
definitions.explanation: Money, gifts, or other valuables given secretly to someone in a position of power or authority to influence their judgment or actions. A serious criminal offense in Japan.

examples.japanese: {賄賂|わいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}した→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
{賄賂|わいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧だ。
examples.english: Accepting a bribe is a crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{政治家|せいじか}→政治家：03084_seijika⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{賄賂|わいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧⟦{容疑|ようぎ}→容疑：12317_yougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The politician was arrested on suspicion of accepting a bribe.

notes:
Refers to illicit payments made to influence someone in a position of authority. In Japanese law, both giving (⟦{贈賄|ぞうわい}→贈賄：21598_zouwai⟧) and receiving (⟦{収賄|しゅうわい}→収賄：27665_shuuwai⟧) bribes are criminal offenses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賄賂|わいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧: to offer a bribe
- {賄賂|わいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to hand over a bribe
- {賄賂|わいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧: to accept a bribe
- {賄賂|わいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}する→要求する：25533_youkyuusuru⟧: to demand a bribe

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{贈賄|ぞうわい}→贈賄：21598_zouwai⟧: the act of giving a bribe (legal term)
- ⟦{収賄|しゅうわい}→収賄：27665_shuuwai⟧: the act of receiving a bribe (legal term)
- ⟦{汚職|おしょく}→汚職：17399_oshoku⟧: corruption — broader term covering all forms of official misconduct
- {袖|そで}の{下|した}: under-the-table payment — literary/euphemistic expression for a bribe
